design.name: 狰
design.brief: A ferocious mythical beast (Zheng of the Shan Hai Jing, five tails and one horn, with a cry like striking stones): a lean muscular crimson leopard with black rosette spots, a dark charcoal face mask and dark charcoal paws (the dark colour block), a cream belly, ONE curved flint-grey horn on its forehead whose tip glows white-gold, bared fangs, and exactly FIVE long whip-like tails. Fierce but loyal; shown pouncing with the five tails lashing.
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing pose on all four legs
design.turnaround_pose: , legs straight and slightly apart, head facing forward, mouth closed, exactly five tails extended backwards and fanned out like a hand so every tail is clearly separate from the others and from the body
design.turnaround_digits: each paw shows four separate clawed toes; the horn and all five tails are never cut off by the frame.
